definitions.explanation: The act of drawing attention to something, especially a problem, error, or important point.

examples.japanese: {問題点|もんだいてん}を{指摘|してき}する。
{専門家|せんもんか}から{指摘|してき}を{受|う}けた。
ご{指摘|してき}の{通|とお}りです。
examples.english: It is as you pointed out.

notes:
{指摘|してき} is commonly used in professional and academic settings for constructive criticism or observations. Often implies pointing out errors or issues.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {指摘|してき}する: to point out
- {指摘|してき}を{受|う}ける: to receive feedback/criticism
- ご{指摘|してき}の{通|とお}り: as you pointed out (formal acknowledgment)
- {問題点|もんだいてん}を{指摘|してき}する: to point out problems

REGISTER:
ご{指摘|してき} is the polite/honorific form, commonly used in business and formal writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {批判|ひはん}: criticism (more negative)
- {注意|ちゅうい}: warning, attention
